key_path: merchant.cashfree.com signup (mobile number + OTP, email, business name)
click 'Switch to Test' in Merchant Dashboard
Developers > API Keys > Generate API Keys (complete 2FA/OTP) -> TEST_ App ID + Secret
production: KYC docs + bank verification; payment expert calls within 24h; activation 24-48 working hours

agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes - mcp.cashfree.com advertises registration_endpoint /oauth/register, PKCE S256, scopes mcp-pg-read/write, mcp-workflows-read/write
agent_native_auth.scoped_restricted_keys: partial - per-product key pairs (PG vs Payouts) and OAuth scopes on MCP; not fine-grained API keys

mcp.type: product MCP (transactions, settlements, reports, payment links, orders, refunds, sandbox payment simulation) + separate Relay MCP for payment workflows

remote.auth: OAuth with DCR (log in with merchant account)

mcp.local: docs mention local option (overview page); not detailed

docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes - Mintlify .md pages, each starts with 'Fetch the complete documentation index' pointer
docs_for_agents.openapi: API reference generated from OpenAPI (Mintlify); no standalone URL verified
docs_for_agents.other: Cashfree Agent Skills (Cursor/Claude Code/Copilot/Gemini CLI), Agent Toolkit (LangChain/Vercel AI/OpenAI Agents), Cashfree HERE (in-chat payments)

score_justification: Full AI stack (OAuth-DCR remote MCP, skills, toolkit, sharded llms.txt) but test keys sit behind phone OTP signup + 2FA on key generation.
best_practice: Sharded llms.txt per product line (/docs/_llms/payments.txt etc.) keeps agent context small.
biggest_gap: No CLI or programmatic key minting; every key generation needs a human OTP.
